title: TAP Run Metadata
description: Written once per analysis run to run-meta.json before any activity or workflow records are appended. Describes the analysis context that is constant across all records in the run.

schemaVersion.description: Semver version of this schema. Additive changes (new nullable fields) increment minor. Breaking changes increment major.

runId.description: Unique identifier for this analysis run. Format: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp + 6-char random hex suffix. Shared by all records in this run.

startedAt.description: UTC timestamp when RunContext.Initialize() was first called (first activity inspection in this run).

completedAt.description: UTC timestamp written by the AppDomain.ProcessExit hook when the analysis child process exits. Null if the process was interrupted before exit.

projectFilePath.description: Absolute path to project.json. Primary reference point for all relative paths in activity and workflow records.

projectOutputType.description: UiPath project output type as reported by IProjectSummary.ProjectOutputType.

projectProfileType.description: UiPath project profile type as reported by IProjectSummary.ProjectProfileType.

expressionLanguage.description: Expression language used in this project.

hasModernBehavior.description: True for projects targeting the Modern design experience.

entryPointName.description: File name of the primary entry-point workflow (e.g. Main.xaml).

tapRuleVersion.description: NuGet package version of Cpmf.WorkflowAnalyzerRules that produced this run.

sdkAssemblyVersion.description: Version of UiPath.Studio.Activities.Api assembly loaded in the rule host. Proxy for Studio version.

writeFailures.description: Count of records where at least one file write failed during this run. A non-zero value indicates the main activity.jsonl or a by-package file may be incomplete.

packagePathAliases.description: Maps sha8 hash prefixes to full package IDs for cases where the by-package path exceeded Windows MAX_PATH and was shortened.
